scripts.generate: if find apps packages -maxdepth 2 -name package.json 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then bun run --filter @harness/api generate && bun run --filter @harness/web-client generate; fi
scripts.test: if find apps packages -maxdepth 2 -name package.json 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then bun run --filter '*' test; fi
scripts.typecheck: if find apps packages -maxdepth 2 -name package.json 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then bun run --filter '*' typecheck; fi
scripts.verify: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/
